items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Carol Pierce made, he was a pianist... And he made a number there, composed a number there by the name of Marguerite.

ctx.x: Yeah, when we made that recording in Indianapolis, at the time, you know, with the big band, that we, with New Orleans, Harlem Kings, we, rap and I played a duet with two guitars. He played the blues and I made the accompaniments, you know, behind him. But we made the recording, but I never heard anything of it. Did he play much? No, I never heard nothing of it. Did he play much? In fact, Carol Pierce, some of the musicians says they heard it, but I never did hear. Carol Pierce, I heard a piano, because we had…
Oh, no. Yeah. The guitar never came out though. Maybe it was a test record. You got Marguerite? Yeah. Yeah. Well, that goes to show it. A lot of people have that. Not a lot, but a few.
Yeah, I heard a couple of them tell me that they heard it.
